name: Vega de Infanzones (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and red with a blue triangle with its base along the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Vega de Infanzones (a lion and a cross with the letters V, G and V).
history: Municipal flag of Vega de Infanzones; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
